name: singlet_abundance_cell_level_da_score
title: Per-cell condition enrichment score
description: Scores each cell by the local ratio of condition densities in an embedding. The default is a sample-grouped, cross-fitted logistic density ratio; MELD and DA-seq are available as published comparators. Requires an embedding plus per-cell sample and two-level condition labels, with condition constant within sample. Writes obs/<method>_score on a balanced scale from -1 to 1, and an FDR flag where the method defines a threshold. Do not use it for replicate-level claims with one sample per condition; use abundance.neighborhood_da_knn_graph for those.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Estimator. The default is the proposed sample-grouped logistic density ratio; meld and daseq are published comparators.

condition_key.description: obs column with two condition levels, constant within each sample.

sample_key.description: obs column with the sample or donor of each cell; defines grouped folds and permutations.

embedding_key.description: obsm key of the embedding: features for the logistic estimator, kNN graph for MELD and DA-seq.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for cross-fitting fold splits and label permutations.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

n_runs.description: Repeats of the fold split; out-of-fold predictions are averaged.

fdr_level.description: Nominal empirical FDR for the flag, from sample-level permutations.

n_perm.description: Sample-level label permutations for the FDR threshold; 0 disables the flag.

meld.description: Options for the MELD heat-filter comparator.

beta.description: Heat-kernel smoothing relative to the largest graph eigenvalue.

order.description: Falloff exponent of the filter; 1 gives the exponential heat kernel.

chebyshev_order.description: Order of the Chebyshev approximation of the filter.

sample_normalize.description: True gives a uniform-prior relative likelihood; false gives the population posterior.

k_fraction_min.description: Smallest neighbourhood size as a fraction of cells.

k_fraction_max.description: Largest neighbourhood size as a fraction of cells; index memory grows with it.

n_perm.description: Cell-level label permutations for the threshold; 2 is the shipped default.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/logistic_density_ratio_score. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_cells, label_sizes, effective_params, threshold, n_flagged. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
